paragraph: No stage is set. Angola's [Backup Data Center do INFOSI](<https://angop.ao/noticias/economia/requalificacao-do-data-center-reforca-soberania-digital-ministro/>) and the [Centro de backup da cloud do Governo](<https://pti.ao/minttics-conclui-modernizacao-do-centro-de-backup-da-cloud-do-governo/>) are each less than 200 km from the main site. No source found names a backup site 200 km or more from the main site, and none dated in the last three years says there is none. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a ministry, agency or the central bank to keep its systems or data at a backup site in service, 200 km or more from its main site or abroad.

No stage is set. The [CAMTEL data centre at Zamengoe (MINFOPRA backup)](<https://www.minfopra.gov.cm/index.php/fr/a-la-une/2021-partenariat-le-minfopra-et-la-camtel-pour-une-convention-de-partenariat-gagnant-gagnant-2>) is the backup site found for Cameroon, and it is less than 200 km from the main site. No source found names a backup site 200 km or more from the main site, and none dated in the last three years says there is none. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [The Central Bank of Egypt tested its disaster recovery site in annual drills](<https://en.amwalalghad.com/egypts-c-bank-conducts-annual-crisis-drill-to-test-continuity-systems/>), in December 2024 and September 2025. No source says where that site is. No source found names a backup site 200 km or more from the main site. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [The IDEA progress report for January-June 2026 says resilient telecom links with the disaster recovery site in Blantyre were commissioned](<https://idea.comesa.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/IDEA-Biannual-implementation-Progress-January-to-June-2026-V-J20-FK-006.pdf>). They serve the Government national data centre in Lilongwe. [The Request for Bids for expanding the National Data Centre describes the Blantyre site as a hot site](<https://api.pppc.mw/api/download/722>), about 320 km from the production site. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No recovery plan or failover test from the past three years has been found for that site. Operating would need a recovery plan or a failover test on record for the backup site.

No stage is set. No source found names the place of that centre or of the main data centre, and none says whether the centre still runs. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [Sudan's General Traffic Police director says the police restored the full vehicle database](<https://sudantribune.net/article/316412>). The director says they set up backup data centres inside the states and outside the country to secure the national vehicle register. The places are not stated beyond states inside Sudan and an unnamed foreign country. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says a backup site 200 km or more away serves the government's shared systems. Establishing would need such a site to serve the national data centre or government cloud.

[Ministry of Finance officials confirmed on 7 January 2026 that no comprehensive disaster-recovery system is yet in place for the national e-GP platform](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/nppa-inspects-e-gp-data-center-finance/>). The platform is hosted in the Ministry's data centre. Disaster recovery is planned for Phase Two, through a Ministry framework or cloud. The main site's place is not stated, and no backup site is named. No change has been found in the last twelve months.
